rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Gives coding assistants secure, read-only access to database schema and data. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, MongoDB, Microsoft SQL Server, and Prisma connections. Provides four core tools: schema discovery, table description, data preview, and safe SELECT queries with enforced row limits. Runs locally via stdio with automatic IDE configuration for Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, and Gemini.
